Editor drafts; only the Manager publishes.\n\nSeam 1 (HTTP): role checks on every route, including hand-crafted POSTs.\nSeam 2 (export): render_site() writes news.html and news-<slug>.html for\npublished posts only.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom app import db\n\n\ndef _csrf(client, path):\n    response = client.get(path)\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    return response.cookies[\"csrf_token\"]\n\n\ndef _new_post(client, slug=\"spring-menu\", title=\"Spring menu\", body=\"Hello.\", **extra):\n    csrf = _csrf(client, \"/admin/posts/new\")\n    return client.post(\n        \"/admin/posts/new\",\n        data={\"slug\": slug, \"title\": title, \"body_md\": body, \"csrf_token\": csrf, **extra},\n        follow_redirects=False,\n    )\n\n\ndef test_editor_creates_a_news_post_as_a_draft(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    response = _new_post(editor)\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    post = db.get_post_by_slug(\"spring-menu\")\n    assert post[\"status\"] == \"draft\"\n    assert post[\"author_id\"] is not None\n\n\ndef test_editor_cannot_create_a_published_post_by_forging_status(client_as):\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    _new_post(editor, status=\"published\")\n    assert db.get_post_by_slug(\"spring-menu\")[\"status\"] == \"draft\"\n"}},"serverClassifierRequest":"9a83006c-0aa7-45d2-acb8-96962999b3e7","apiBlockIndex":2,"requestId":"req_011CfyWHTTdPkAMxzoeE8HkC","requestedModel":"claude-sonnet-5-5","attributionSkill":"mattpocock-skills:tdd","attributionPlugin":"mattpocock-skills","type":"assistant","uuid":"f62304da-b087-4211-a4d0-0be519981c7c","timestamp":"2026-10-13T03:12:49.518Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"medium","perTurnEffort":"medium","session_id":"68fe07ff-a133-4d44-8ff0-716e95c03e55","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/alejandrogonzalez/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"68fe07ff-a133-4d44-8ff0-716e95c03e55","version":"2.1.296","gitBranch":"main"}

The user can send it another message and resume it, so the same task-id may notify more than once.</note>\n<result>```json\n[\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/publish.py\",\n    \"line\": 54,\n    \"summary\": \"render_site() deletes the whole output directory before it validates the news-slug collision, so the new ValueError leaves site/ empty.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"A published page with slug 'news' or 'news-old' exists. `cms publish` runs `shutil.rmtree(out)`, recreates the directory, and writes only style.css. It then raises ValueError at the clash check. The previous good site/ is gone, and the half-built directory has no index.html. If site/ is what gets deployed to GitHub Pages, the deploy ships a blank site. The check should run before the rmtree, or the site should be rendered into a temp directory and swapped in.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/routes/pages.py\",\n    \"line\": 140,\n    \"summary\": \"The news-namespace guard exists only in page creation and at export. page_edit_submit lets the Manager publish an existing 'news' or 'news-*' draft page.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"A draft page 'news-old' already exists, which is the case the db.py comment describes. The Manager opens it in /admin/pages/news-old, sets status=published and saves. The admin UI accepts it. The next render_site() raises ValueError and aborts, so the export is broken until someone fixes the page by hand. The guard should also apply on update, or the status change should be refused for these slugs.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/db.py\",\n    \"line\": 237,\n    \"summary\": \"pages_conflicting_with_news() is documented as the way existing conflicts are reported, but nothing calls it outside tests. No dashboard, CLI or seed script surfaces the conflicts.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"An existing Page 'news' is silently left in the database. The Manager gets no warning in the admin UI. The conflict only shows up as a crash at publish time, after the output directory was already wiped. The 'reported only' behavior is not implemented in any user-facing path.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/routes/posts.py\",\n    \"line\": 351,\n    \"summary\": \"Post slugs are validated only by db.slug_is_valid, which reserves just 'index'. A post can be created with the slug 'new', and the static /admin/posts/new route shadows /admin/posts/{slug}.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"An Editor creates a post with slug 'new'. The create succeeds and redirects to /admin/posts/new, which renders the 'New News post' form instead of the editor. The list link for that post points to the same URL. Its content can never be opened or edited in the UI. If it is published it still exports as news-new.html, but it is stuck as a draft until the Manager POSTs to /admin/posts/new/publish by hand. The route-order comment shows the author knew this class of problem. The slug should be reserved.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/routes/posts.py\",\n    \"line\": 409,\n    \"summary\": \"post_edit_submit and post_new_submit accept a whitespace-only title. Form(...) only rejects a missing or empty field, and update_post/create_post store whatever they get.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"A user submits title='   '. The post saves with a blank title. Once published, news.html lists an empty link with no visible text, and the news-&lt;slug&gt;.html page has an empty h1 and a title of ' — Site'. The same blank title also appears as an unclickable entry in /admin/posts.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/publish.py\",\n    \"line\": 230,\n    \"summary\": \"The public News date and ordering use created_at, not the publish date. Nothing records when a post was published or edited.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"A draft is created in March and the Manager publishes it in October. It shows 'March' on news.html and sorts below posts created later but published earlier. The announcement looks stale and is buried. Unpublishing and republishing does not change the date either. A published_at column set in set_post_status would fix both the displayed date and the sort order.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/routes/posts.py\",\n    \"line\": 444,\n    \"summary\": \"post_delete is a destructive one-click action with no confirmation. Any Editor can delete any draft, including drafts by other authors. The delete form on the list page is unguarded.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"An Editor clicks 'Delete' next to a draft that another Editor spent hours on, or mis-clicks next to the title link. The row is hard-deleted from SQLite with no undo, no soft-delete and no ownership check. The loss is unrecoverable.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/publish.py\",\n    \"line\": 89,\n    \"summary\": \"The per-post render loop is a copy of the page loop above it, differing only in the filename. The News index and the post loop also repeat the same four context kwargs.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"Any change to page rendering, such as adding a canonical link, a date line or another context variable, has to be made in two or three places. Pages and posts will drift apart. A single helper like _write(name, title, body_md) or a shared base-context dict would remove the duplication.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/routes/posts.py\",\n    \"line\": 298,\n    \"summary\": \"_require_manager is re-implemented here. app/routes/pages.py has an almost identical copy, and the new _require_staff duplicates the login check inside it.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"The role check is the core access-control rule. If the login redirect or the 403 behavior changes in one module and not the other, the Pages and News routes enforce different auth. The helpers should live once in app/auth.py, for example require_user(request, roles=...).\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"tests/test_posts.py\",\n    \"line\": 854,\n    \"summary\": \"Imports (re, pytest, render_site) sit mid-file with `# noqa: E402` to suppress lint, and the db.py CRUD tests share a table-driven setup that is repeated by hand.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"This is a maintenance cost. The suppression hides a real E402 and the imports are easy to miss when editing. Moving the imports to the top removes the noqa markers and keeps the file consistent with the repo's other test modules.\"\n  }\n]\n```</result>\n<usage><subagent_tokens>67113</subagent_tokens><tool_uses>4</tool_uses><duration_ms>42049</duration_ms></usage>\n</task-notification>"}

{"parentUuid":"19f95a5c-2caa-4b1d-8abd-601dcdf7ba34","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CfyWibX1oTXfxzLgtFUL4","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01ASaikhjyhKvoGgDkZVGj3h","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cat > \"$TMPDIR/t04-review.md\" <<'EOF'\n## T04 `/code-review` (high effort, independent agent) and resolutions\n\nModel: Sonnet 5.5, medium effort for implementation (per `notes/usage-ledger.csv`).\n\n| # | Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---|---|\n| 1 | `render_site()` wiped `site/` before the News-namespace check, so a refused export left an empty site | **Fixed.** The check runs before anything is deleted. Test: `test_a_failed_export_leaves_the_previous_site_untouched` |\n| 2 | The Manager could publish an existing `news-*` draft Page from the edit form, which would break the next export | **Fixed.** The edit route refuses it with a 400 and a message; the page is not changed. Test: `test_manager_cannot_publish_a_page_in_the_news_namespace` |\n| 3 | `pages_conflicting_with_news()` was never surfaced to a user | **Fixed.** `/admin/pages` shows a warning listing conflicting Pages, saying they were not changed or deleted. Test: `test_pages_list_warns_about_pages_in_the_news_namespace` |\n| 4 | A post slugged `new` was shadowed by the static `/admin/posts/new` route | **Fixed.** `new` joins `index` in the reserved slugs (this also closes the same hole for Pages). Test: `test_a_post_cannot_take_the_slug_of_a_static_admin_route` |\n| 5 | Whitespace-only titles were accepted | **Fixed** on create and edit (400, nothing saved; titles are stripped). Test: `test_a_blank_title_is_rejected_on_create_and_edit` |\n| 6 | The public date and ordering used `created_at`, not the publish date | **Fixed.** New `posts.published_at` is stamped on publish and cleared on unpublish; the export shows and sorts by it. The seed passes the Michelin item's real date. Test: `test_the_public_date_and_order_follow_the_publish_date_not_the_draft_date` |\n| 7 | One-click hard delete, and an Editor can delete any draft | **Partly fixed.** The delete form now asks for confirmation. **Not changed, by decision:** no per-author ownership rule. The ticket restricts only deleting *published* posts, drafts are shared between Editors, and `author_id` is overwritten on every save, so \"own\" is ambiguous. No soft-delete, so a confirmed delete is permanent. |\n| 8 | Duplicate render loops in `render_site()` | **Fixed.** One `write_item` helper and a shared layout context. |\n| 9 | Role/login check duplicated in two route modules | **Fixed.** `auth.require_role()` is used by both Pages and News routes. |\n| 10 | Mid-file imports with `noqa: E402` in the test module | **Fixed.** Hoisted to the top. |\n\nKnown limitation (not from the review): the News-namespace check protects `cms publish`; if a legacy Page already uses `news` or `news-…`, it stays in the database untouched and the export is refused until it is renamed or unpublished.\n\n## Tests\n\n- `uv run pytest`: **110 passed** (79 before this ticket; 31 new in `tests/test_posts.py`).\n- Seams: HTTP (`client` / `client_as`, including hand-crafted Editor POSTs with valid and forged CSRF tokens) and export (`render_site()` output).\n- Covers: Editor create/edit stays draft even with a forged `status`; {"parentUuid":"6607d4b3-06fe-421b-b5b0-b3c0f73d4904","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CfyWjwFh2yYJ8yMQWF5vD","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01PFExUDfMAYA69R6sKttau2","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"git add app/auth.py app/db.py app/main.py app/publish.py app/routes/pages.py app/routes/posts.py scripts/seed_demo.py templates/admin/dashboard.html templates/admin/page_edit.html templates/admin/pages_list.html templates/admin/post_edit.html templates/admin/post_new.html templates/admin/posts_list.html templates/public/news_index.html tests/test_posts.py && git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'\nT04: News posts with Editor drafts and Manager publish\n\nEditors create and edit News as drafts; status is never read from a form, so\na forged request cannot publish. {"parentUuid":"c808e8ff-eb2e-4524-83ad-311251152fcc","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CfyWmFS6xpfUBNFASv5fG","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"T04 (issue #5) is built, reviewed, committed as `88e7480`, and pushed. GitHub closed #5 from the `Closes #5` line. All 110 tests pass: 79 before this ticket plus 31 new ones.\n\n## What was built\n- **Editors:** An Editor can create and edit a News post, and every save leaves it a draft. Status is never read from the form, so a forged `status=published` is ignored.\n- **Publishing:** Only the Manager publishes, unpublishes or deletes published posts. A direct POST from an Editor gets a 403. An Editor also can't open, edit or delete a published post.\n- **Export:** `cms publish` writes `news.html` and `news-<slug>.html` for published posts only. The index is newest first and linked from the nav. Unpublishing and re-exporting removes the old file.\n- **Collisions:** `news` and the `news-` prefix are reserved for News. Pages can't be created with them, and existing conflicting Pages are listed in `/admin/pages` and never deleted. If a published Page conflicts, the export refuses to run and leaves the previous `site/` untouched.\n- **Seed content:** The seed adds the dated Michelin item (2026-08-24, the date of the Michelin article it cites), one published demo post and one demo draft. The demo posts are labelled `[DEMO CONTENT]`.\n\n## Review\nThe independent `/code-review` returned 10 findings. I fixed 9 and fixed 1 only in part. The full findings, resolutions and test results are posted on #5. These are the ones you may care about:\n- **Wiped site on refused export:** the export deleted `site/` before checking for slug collisions. The check now runs first.\n- **Publish date:** the public date and order used the draft's creation date. A new `published_at` column fixes that.\n- **Unreachable posts:** a post or page slugged `new` could never be opened. `new` is now reserved.\n- **Delete (partly fixed):** I added a confirmation prompt, but not a per-author ownership rule. The ticket restricts only deleting published posts, and `author_id` changes on every save, so \"own\" is ambiguous. A confirmed delete is permanent. Say if you want an ownership rule.\n\n## Left alone, as you asked\n- **Uncommitted:** the token budget draft is still awaiting your review, and so are `notes/usage-ledger.csv` and transcript 07 (still needs a secrets check).\n- **Field notes:** the WordPress observations are still 3 of 5 and unfinished.\n- **Stage 1:** it is not complete. No `mp2-mvp` tag exists, and the checker is 11/12 with only the tag failing.\n- **Not deployed:** I did not run `cms publish` or `cms deploy`, so the live site doesn't have News yet.\n\n## Open question\nThe Oct 6–7 Stage 2 deadline has passed. Confirm with your instructor whether Stage 1 and Stage 2 still count before spending more effort. Remaining tickets are #6 (T05 dashboard), #7 (T06 users) and #8 (T07 hardening)."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"end_turn","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":268,"cache_read_input_tokens":138663,"output_tokens":1027,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":268,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1027,"cache_read_input_tokens":138663,"cache_creation_input_tokens":268,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":268},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"serverClassifierRequest":"5ae8dba5-b278-44d1-bc7f-bebade813c77","apiBlockIndex":0,"requestId":"req_011CfyWmF7Fdfw6LfoH4e5ib","requestedModel":"claude-sonnet-5-5","type":"assistant","uuid":"6fa26007-f09e-4a6b-9d4a-acfa841f6e48","timestamp":"2026-10-13T03:19:06.950Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"medium","perTurnEffort":"medium","session_id":"68fe07ff-a133-4d44-8ff0-716e95c03e55","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/alejandrogonzalez/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"68fe07ff-a133-4d44-8ff0-716e95c03e55","version":"2.1.296","gitBranch":"main"}
